name: Xiao Yi
source: Osborn is a professional racing driver who has won four consecutive R1 racing championships. Thanks to his abilities, he is known as a prodigy in the sport. To the public, he is a racer with a rebellious streak. Few know that his hidden identity is that of a bounter hunter from the LONGDAY union. In this world of bounty hunters, regardless of good or evil, there is only the strong and weak.
